text: Need a way to implement disaster recovery of agent session ending suddenly, which can happen when using a remote server or if the power gets shut off.  This may involve a combination of agent harness improvements and backlogit tooling.  Need to perform adequate research and analysis to understand what this feature entails.

Add a stash.jsonl file to .backlogit/archive/ that collects each stash entry as it is staged and pulled into a shipment after deliberation. This preserves a durable record of all prior stash entries, including their original text, priority, kind, linked deliberation ID, and the harvested artifact ID. Currently, removed stash entries disappear entirely from stash.jsonl with no historical trace.

Fix documentation for stash subcommands so all docs use the current CLI names and arguments. Update stale references to `stash fetch-stash` to `stash list`, document the current `get`, `edit`, and `remove` commands, and make examples consistent with the supported flags like `--kind`, `--priority`, and `--group-by-priority`. Affected docs currently include README.md, docs/workflow.md, and docs/configuration.md.

Make semantic links durable outside SQLite. `item_links` is currently written only to the ephemeral `backlogit.db` and explicitly preserved across rehydrate, which breaks the CQRS promise that the DB is disposable. Persist typed links in Markdown or JSONL and rebuild them during sync so deleting the cache loses nothing.

Constrain `backlogit_export_command_map` to `.backlogit/` or ratify a formal exception. `WriteCommandMap` resolves paths against the repo root instead of `.backlogit`, so the MCP/CLI export can write anywhere in the repository and bypass the normal write-only containment boundary.

Restore verification integrity for formatting. The repo currently has 39 unformatted Go files, and the Unix `Makefile` `fmt` target runs `gofmt -l .` without failing on output, so `make all` can go green while formatting drift remains. Align verification surfaces and bring the tree back to a true gofmt-clean state.

Fix current documentation accuracy outside stash docs. `docs/workflow.md` shows unsupported CLI syntax (`backlogit move T042 done`, `dep add --depends-on`, `list --label`, `update --commit`); `docs/installation.md` advertises `backlogit --version` though no version flag exists and still says Go 1.22 while `go.mod` requires 1.24; `AGENTS.md` and some instructions still refer to `index.db` while runtime uses `backlogit.db`.

Fix CLI add/update coherence. `newAddCommand` and `newUpdateCommand` duplicate file and DB writes that `core.CreateArtifact` and `core.UpdateArtifact` already perform, and CLI add still lacks several creation-time fields exposed by MCP (`priority`, `assigned_to`, `owner`, `labels`, `dependencies`, `references`).

Harden MCP consistency and rehydration contracts. Key gaps: ErrNotFound is returned as `internal` in several item handlers, `handleListShipments` returns a different `custom_fields.items` shape than `get_shipment`, `ensureWorkspace` lazily initializes without synchronization, `DeleteAllItemLogs` happens outside the main rehydrate transaction, and item deletion leaves orphaned rows in `commit_links`, `item_links`, and `stash_links`.

Fix `backlogit_adopt_item` to atomically rewrite IDs and rename files. Adoption currently changes only `parent_id`, leaving the old hierarchical ID, Markdown filename, and log filenames in place even though the orphaned-task compound doc calls for full ID rewrite, file rename, manifest updates, and index sync.

Add stash hygiene to the Stage workflow. Stage agent guidance still lacks a standard stale-stash pruning step even though stash entries now expose `age_days` and support `stash remove` and `stash edit`; update the agent protocol and refresh the stale compound doc so future agents stop falling back to raw `stash.jsonl` edits.

Enforce SQLite per-connection PRAGMAs consistently. `db.Open` sets `foreign_keys=ON` and `busy_timeout=5000` via `db.Exec`, which only affects the current pooled connection. New connections can come up with defaults, so foreign keys and busy timeouts are not reliably enforced unless we constrain the pool (`SetMaxOpenConns(1)`) or apply pragmas per connection/DSN.

Restore Markdown-first invariants in update and move paths. `UpdateArtifact` silently skips the Markdown write if `FindArtifactPath` fails and still upserts SQLite, `backlogit_move_item` in MCP updates status without relocating the file per registry routing, and `BulkUpdateStatus` commits the DB before best-effort Markdown sync. These flows can leave file and DB state diverged until the next rehydrate overwrites one side.

Tighten query-gate and section-write correctness. The SQL gate rejects valid read-only queries when semicolons appear inside string literals, and `writeSectionsToFile` treats every `WriteSections` error as 'section not found' and appends new markers, which can duplicate or corrupt sections on structural parse failures.

Fix workflow edge-case invariants in stash harvest and status blocking. `HarvestStashByPriority` reads the batch before locking and then harvests entries one by one, leaving a TOCTOU window for spurious failures, and `TerminalStatuses` omits `rejected`, so rejecting a parent can bypass the child-blocking guard that applies to other terminal outcomes.
Internal lifecycle hooks for validation, cascade, and enforcement
External system hooks with prioritized notification push support for Slack, Teams, and webhooks
